description: This file defines models and a fetcher for retrieving and processing port volume data from EconDB, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and HTTP request handling.

classes.name: EconDbPortVolumeQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for port volume data, including date validation.

classes.name: EconDbPortVolumeData
classes.description: Data model for port volume information, including dwell times and TEU counts.

classes.name: EconDbPortVolumeFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process port volume data from EconDB API.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates that start and end dates are after 2022-04-03.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from EconDB API.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured port volume data objects.
